'''Shannon Baksa''' (later '''Shannon Lynn McRandle''', née Jones) is the model Decipher cast as Mara Jade. She was a special guest at [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 2000]]. Her likeness is on [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] from [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] and on the Light Side [[Mara Jade]] from Virtual Set 17.<ref name="databank">[https://web.archive.org/web/20110807051128/http://starwars.com/databank/character/marajadeskywalker/index.html Mara Jade Skywalker], Star Wars Databank (Wayback 7 August 2011)</ref><ref name="tfn">[http://www.theforce.net/videogames/story/Shannon_Baksa_is_Mara_Jade_78191.asp Shannon Baksa is Mara Jade], TheForce.net (12 November 1999)</ref><ref name="pc-x">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1828839249443262568 @swccg], 28 August 2024</ref>

[[File:DecipherCon 2000 Shannon Baksa signing.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Baksa signing at DecipherCon 2000, 6 October 2000]]

Decipher's DecipherCon '99 guest bio called her Star Wars' "Mara Jade": a professional model and make-up artist, cast by Decipher, who would sign photographs at the convention.<ref name="bio">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000304010455/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/shannonbio.html Shannon Baksa — Star Wars' "Mara Jade"], Decipher (Wayback 4 March 2000)</ref>

== Convention guest ==

At DecipherCon '99 (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach) she signed Friday 1–3pm and Saturday/Sunday 12–2pm. Francis K. Lalumiere wrote that she appeared as Mara Jade in full costume.<ref name="sat">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Lalumiere Saturday], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback)</ref>

At DecipherCon 2000 (5–8 October 2000, Kissimmee) she returned with [[Michonne Bourriague]]. Surviving official photographs show her signing table (6 October) and a magazine feature "Who is Mara Jade?" (8 October).

== Likeness on SWCCG cards ==

The Star Wars Databank: "Decipher Inc. hired model Shannon Baksa to pose as Mara for a number of card images. Many subsequent products have since borne Baksa's likeness to represent Mara." The first cited product is the live-action photo for Enhanced Jabba's Palace.<ref name="databank" />

* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] — Enhanced Jabba's Palace premium (die-cut pack with [[Bossk With Mortar Gun]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This...]])
* The same title as a Reflections II foil
* Oversized Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand convention promo (spend $20 at the Decipher store)
* Oversized group promo: Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde (same store promo)
* Light Side [[Mara Jade]] (Virtual Set 17) — Players Committee: "Mrs. McRandle image also appears on the LS Card Mara Jade from V-Set 17."<ref name="pc-x" />

Art director Dan Burns ran a local-model search; she later appeared as a Decipher convention representative with a lit lightsaber. An unproduced Decipher Light Side Mara was shot and never printed; that work later informed the Virtual Set 17 card.<ref name="set17">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/light-side-mara-jade-virtual-set-17-spoiler/ Light Side Mara Jade, Virtual Set 17 spoiler], Players Committee</ref>

== Interviews ==

=== NanashiStudios, 10 December 2021 ===

[[File:Shannon McRandle 2021 interview.png|thumb|right|280px|Shannon McRandle, Mara Jade]]

brandon baity (NanashiStudios) posted ''Shannon McRandle (Mara Jade) Preview'' on 10 December 2021 (7 minutes 54 seconds). She is on camera from about 0:18. The title marks it as a preview.<ref name="mcrandle">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOX0cT3ukR8 Shannon McRandle (Mara Jade) Preview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (10 December 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-oOX0cT3ukR8 Internet Archive].</ref>

She introduces herself as Shannon McRandle, formerly Shannon Baksa, hired as the living face of Mara Jade for Decipher's ''Star Wars'' game cards. A ''Star Wars Insider'' poll had made Mara the fan-favorite character who had never been on film. The casting call asked for a 5'9–5'10 redhead, dancer-type, strong. The photographer already shooting the project brought her in before the call; Decipher then cancelled the open casting.<ref name="mcrandle" />

She describes herself as an old-school board-game player. Her first meeting was at Decipher, then a comic shop to research Mara. Decipher had mock-ups of comic covers and artist ideas; Mara had never had one look. She read the first two Zahn novels before the second interview. For the shoot she lightened her hair orangey-red and wore green contacts.<ref name="mcrandle" />

She calls Mara the first female character who was almost the opposite of Leia: a bad guy you fall in love with. On the work itself: "if it had just been that one day that one card and a couple of DecipherCons I would have been ecstatic." Being Mara introduced her to the wider ''Star Wars'' world; she dates that span as 20 of her 50 years. She says she would not call herself iconic: "Mara Jade is iconic and to have been able to stand in her boots for a moment."<ref name="mcrandle" />
